criteria.description: App.tsx closes the <ProductList> JSX element with /> before the sibling <div className="pagination">.
criteria.evidence: App.tsx line 47 reads `<ProductList products={visibleProducts} />`. Build exits with code 0 — no parse error. Previously the unclosed tag caused `Expected ">" but found "<"` at App.tsx:48; that error is gone.

criteria.description: ProductCard.tsx references product.discountPct (not product.discountPercent) in all three places: hasDiscount assignment, badge text, and formatPrice call.
criteria.evidence: ProductCard.tsx line 9: `const hasDiscount = product.discountPct != null;`, line 25: `-{product.discountPct}%`, line 37: `{formatPrice(product.price, product.discountPct)}`. All three occurrences use `discountPct`. Build exits with code 0 (TypeScript accepted the field). `pnpm test` reports `✓ tests/app.render.test.tsx (1 test) 57ms` — the suite rendering ProductCard instances passed.

criteria.evidence: SortSelect.tsx line 16 reads `onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value as FilterState['sortBy'])}`. criteria.description: All visible tests pass after the above fixes with no test file modifications.
